prefix: modes 1-2 solved once per seed on the committed (a') path (network storage, diagonal rule); the raw stored pair is shared by the three arms

arms.rf_frozen: the same pair orthogonalized at storage time (classical Gram-Schmidt, Rowan-style) + diagonal rule; later stages store their deflated state

storage: modes from 3 on are kept as arrays at the fixed Gauss nodes (the same deflation as re-evaluating the network there; tested)
